rdfs:label: Vcalendar
rdfs:comment: An iCalendar container — the top-level wrapper holding a collection of Vevents, Vtodos, and other calendar components.
notes: An `.ics` file's outermost element. A pod's calendar resource is typically a `Vcalendar` containing many `Vevent` and `Vtodo` members — analogous to a Container in LDP terms. Carries calendar-wide metadata (timezone, product ID). Member events and to-dos link from the calendar via `ical:component`.

history.note: Example now contains the event it promises (via ical:component); notes say members link via ical:component.
